revisions.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production website character sprite sheet, 1536 x 1024 pixels, landscape.
Input image: edit target, existing Jakub sheet. Preserve this exact recognizable man's face, short light-brown swept hair, short beard, skin tone, friendly adult caricature proportions, polished shaded illustration style and ivory background. Change clothing and props in ALL THREE poses according to this brief.

Layout is crucial: exactly THREE separate full-body poses, LEFT celebrate, CENTER explain, RIGHT encourage, in three equal 512-pixel-wide cells. Centers at x=256, 768, 1280. All content for each pose INCLUDING hands, feet, props and shadows must stay within its own 360-pixel-wide zone: left x=76..435, middle x=588..947, right x=1100..1459. Keep the complete full-height vertical columns x=436..587 and x=948..1099 completely empty solid ivory #fff8ed. Generous 76-pixel ivory side gutters around each cell. No neighboring pose or prop bleed. All feet, heads and props completely visible within y=50..940, comparable body scale across poses. Preserve a solid ivory #fff8ed background, clean isolated sprites with no scenery.

Jakub now wears a NORMAL plain black short-sleeve T-shirt, dark blue jeans, everyday sneakers in ALL THREE poses. Remove EVERY folk costume piece, vest, embroidery, wide ornamented belt, axe and boot from ALL poses. Preserve his face and hairstyle accurately.

LEFT: cheerful celebratory thumbs-up, with one tiny orange dimpled IR golf ball visible in the other hand, and a bundle of two very long straight plain slim poles held upright beside him. The poles extend well above the top of his head and remain fully visible within y=50..940; use slim plain straight rods, no shaped heads.
CENTER: explaining while holding a tiny palm-sized rectangular ESP electronics circuit board with a small metal ESP module and a small black OLED screen showing blue/white pixels. A tiny orange dimpled IR golf ball visible nearby in his other hand. Both are small genuine electronics/sports objects: ball real golf-ball size approximately 42 mm, smaller than his palm, not a full-sized soccer ball; board palm-sized, not a toy robot.
RIGHT: encouraging gesture next to a small streaming camera on a slim tripod, while carrying a very long plain slim straight pole upright, extending well above his head and fitting fully in frame. Keep tripod, camera, pole and his entire silhouette in the right cell.

No folk or nationality costume; no embroidery; no axes, weapons or crooks; no boots; no full-sized soccer balls; no toy robots; no captions, names, labels, frames, dividers, watermark or other people. Exactly three separate poses, with clean wide ivory gutters.
